market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Iran strikes, Warsh hawkishness, September seasonality, and job revision create headwinds. Oil above $90 supports energy but pressures broad equities. Expect 3-5% S&P 500 drawdown risk into mid-September. Volatility elevated.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Tariff refunds support consumer spending; AI capex cycle continues despite scrutiny; EM reform (Chile, India) offers rotation opportunities. Fed may pause if labor data weakens further. 6-12 month path depends on Iran de-escalation and AI revenue realization.
